name: Climate club negotiation 2025-2055
description: Six major economies negotiate emission cuts over six five-year periods under a continuous CO2-temperature model, with an optional climate club (common carbon price, border tariffs on non-members).

countries.description: One row per negotiating country (2025 values).

club_enabled.description: Whether a climate club can be joined.

tariffs_enabled.description: Whether club members may levy a border carbon tariff on non-members.

club_price.description: Common carbon price every club member must apply.

backstop_price.description: Carbon price at which a 100% cut pays off; sets abatement cost: cost share of GDP = backstop x intensity / 2000 x cut^2.

tariff_incidence.description: Share of a border tariff's value that is lost to the exporting economy.

decarbonization.description: Autonomous yearly decline in emissions intensity.

rest_of_world_emissions.description: Emissions from countries outside the negotiation.

co2_2020.description: Atmospheric CO2 in 2020; the first physics step brings it to 2025.

airborne_fraction.description: Share of emitted CO2 that stays in the atmosphere at first.

co2_removal_rate.description: Yearly uptake of excess CO2 (above 280 ppm) by oceans and land.

temperature_lag.description: Time constant with which temperature follows its CO2 equilibrium.

brief.situation: It is 2025. Six economies that emit most of the world's CO2 meet every five years until 2055 to negotiate climate policy. Warming already stands near +1.3 degC and rises with atmospheric CO2, with a lag of decades. You are the chief negotiator of your country: protect its long-run prosperity.
brief.rules:
Each meeting (one round = five years) has three steps. 1) Forum: speak to all delegations, write privately to one, then call done_talking. 2) Pledges: publicly pledge a cut in emissions (% below business-as-usual) and, if a climate club exists, join or leave it. 3) Implementation: privately choose the cut you actually make this period; everyone sees your measured cut at the next meeting.
Economics: GDP grows at your baseline rate minus climate damages of vulnerability x temperature^2 per year, and everyone suffers from world warming whoever emits. Cutting costs a share of GDP that rises with the square of the cut (dirtier economies pay more per % cut).
Climate club: members apply the common carbon price, which forces a minimum cut. Members may levy a border carbon tariff on non-members' exports, costing non-members GDP. Tariff revenue is recycled at home and not counted. Rest-of-world emissions continue unchanged.

negotiating.description: True in the six meeting rounds; the last round only settles the climate in 2055.

club_min_cut.description: Minimum cut (%) implied by the club carbon price.

abatement_share.description: Share of GDP spent to cut emissions by `cut` percent.

border_rate.description: Ad-valorem border tariff on an exporter with this carbon intensity.

tariff_share.description: Share of GDP a country loses to border tariffs this period.

year.description: Calendar year at the start of this round (clock.start does not label years).

share.description: A GDP share as a percentage with two decimals.

gdp.description: GDP after abatement and tariff costs, $ trillion.

potential.description: GDP before this period's abatement and tariff costs, $ trillion.

bau_gdp.description: GDP on a path with no warming, no abatement and no tariffs.

intensity.description: Emissions intensity, kgCO2 per $ (= GtCO2 per $ trillion).

cut.description: Cut actually chosen for this period (secret until measured).

last_cut.description: Measured cut of the last completed period.

abatement_cost.description: Share of GDP spent on abatement last period.

tariff_cost.description: Share of GDP lost to border tariffs last period.

output_lost.description: Cumulative GDP lost versus the no-warming, no-policy path, $ trillion.

population.name: {$row.name}
population.brief: You represent {$actor.name}: {$actor.population|int} million people, GDP ${$actor.gdp|1} trillion growing {$actor.growth|pct} a year before climate damages, emitting {$actor.emissions|1} GtCO2 a year ({$actor.intensity|2} kg per $). Climate vulnerability {$actor.vulnerability|4}: at +2 degC warming your growth loses {$share(4 * $actor.vulnerability)} a year. Exports are {$actor.exports|pct} of GDP.

T.rate: years * (S * log(C / C0) / log(2) - T) / tau

speak.description: Say something to every delegation in the shared forum.
speak.outcome: Your statement is in the forum.

write.description: Send a private message to one other delegation.
write.outcome: Your message was delivered privately to {$params.to.name}.

done_talking.description: You have nothing more to say this meeting.

join_club.description: Join the climate club: from this period you must cut at least the club minimum (the common carbon price). Choose whether you levy a border tariff on non-members.

when.why: There is no climate club in this scenario.

tariff.description: Levy the border carbon tariff on non-members (only if tariffs are allowed).

then.fail: Border tariffs are not allowed in this scenario; join with tariff false.

join_club.outcome: {$actor.name} is now a club member{$' levying the border tariff' if $params.tariff else ''}.
join_club.announce: {$actor.name} joins the climate club{$' and levies a border tariff on non-members' if $params.tariff else ''}.

set_tariff.description: As a club member, switch your border carbon tariff on non-members on or off.

when.why: Only club members can levy the border tariff.
Border tariffs are not allowed in this scenario.

then.fail: Your tariff is already {$'on' if $actor.tariff else 'off'}.

set_tariff.announce: {$actor.name} {$'imposes' if $params.on else 'lifts'} its border carbon tariff.

leave_club.description: Leave the climate club (you will face members' border tariffs).

pledge.description: Publicly pledge your emission cut for this five-year period, in % below business-as-usual. Change club status before pledging.

implement.description: Choose the emission cut you actually make this period (% below business-as-usual). Secret now; measured and shown to all next meeting. Club members cannot go below the club minimum.
implement.outcome: You will cut {$params.cut|1}% this period, costing about {$share($abatement_share($params.cut, $actor.intensity))} of GDP a year.

stages.name: forum
stages.brief: Meeting of {$year()} (period {$year()}-{$year() + 5}). Forum: speak to all and/or write privately to one delegation, then call done_talking.

stages.name: pledging
stages.brief: Pledges for {$year()}-{$year() + 5}: change club status first if you wish (join_club, set_tariff, leave_club), then pledge your cut; pledge ends your turn.

stages.name: implementation
stages.brief: Choose your actual cut for {$year()}-{$year() + 5}. Your pledge was {$actor.pledge|1}%{$'; as a club member you must cut at least ' + $fmt($club_min_cut(), 1) + '%' if $actor.member else ''}.

events.name: settle_period
events.say: Period settled: the six emit {$fmt($sum(country, $it.emissions), 1)} GtCO2 a year; club members: {$count(country, $it.member)}.

negotiated_emissions.description: GtCO2 emitted by the six since 2025.

climate.title: Climate
climate.show: {$year()}: CO2 {$fmt($physics.C, 1)} ppm, warming +{$fmt($physics.T, 2)} degC above pre-industrial. In {$year() - 5}-{$year()} the six emitted {$fmt($sum(country, $it.emissions), 1)} GtCO2/yr and the rest of the world {$inputs.rest_of_world_emissions}. World emissions since 2025: {$fmt($world.cumulative_emissions, 0)} GtCO2.

club.title: Climate club
club.show: Carbon price {$inputs.club_price|money} per tonne, so members cut at least {$fmt($club_min_cut(), 1)}%. Members: {$join($map($filter(country, $it.member), $it.name + (' (tariff)' if $it.tariff else ''))) if $any(country, $it.member) else 'none'}.{$' Border tariffs: a non-member exporter with carbon intensity i pays ' + $fmt($inputs.club_price / 1000, 2) + ' x i ad valorem on sales to tariffing members.' if $inputs.tariffs_enabled else ' Border tariffs are not allowed.'}

countries.title: Delegations (GDP $ trillion; cuts % below business-as-usual)
countries.show: [{id}] {name}: GDP {gdp|1} ({$share(1 - $it.gdp / $it.bau_gdp)} below no-warming path), emits {emissions|2} Gt/yr, pledged {pledge|0}%, measured cut {last_cut|0}%{$', club member' if $it.member else ''}{$' with tariff' if $it.tariff else ''}, vulnerability {vulnerability|4}

my_economy.title: Your economy
my_economy.show: Business-as-usual emissions for {$year()}-{$year() + 5}: {$fmt($bau_emissions($actor), 2)} Gt/yr. Yearly cost of a cut, share of GDP: 10% = {$share($abatement_share(10, $actor.intensity))}, 25% = {$share($abatement_share(25, $actor.intensity))}, 50% = {$share($abatement_share(50, $actor.intensity))}, 100% = {$share($abatement_share(100, $actor.intensity))}. Climate damages now cut your growth by {$share($actor.vulnerability * $physics.T ** 2)} a year. Last period you spent {$share($actor.abatement_cost)} of GDP on abatement and lost {$share($actor.tariff_cost)} to tariffs.{$' Outside the club, current tariffs would cost you ' + $share($inputs.tariff_incidence * $actor.exports * $border_rate($actor.intensity) * $sum(country, $it.potential, $it.member and $it.tariff) / $sum(country, $it.potential)) + ' of GDP a year.' if ($inputs.tariffs_enabled and not $actor.member) else ''}

negotiated_cumulative_emissions.description: GtCO2 emitted 2025-2055 by the six countries.

gdp_loss_pct.description: 2055 GDP shortfall versus the no-warming, no-policy path, %.

cumulative_output_lost.description: GDP lost 2025-2055 versus the no-warming, no-policy path, $ trillion.

pledge_gap.description: Average pledged minus average actual cut, percentage points.

invariants.why: Every settled period, club members cut at least the club minimum.

rules.when: $stage == pledging and $inputs.club_enabled and not $actor.member and ($count(country, $it.member) >= 2 or $actor.tariff_cost > 0)

no_club.description: No climate club: only voluntary pledges.

club_tariffs.description: Climate club with a common carbon price; members may levy border tariffs on non-members.
